title: Coherent authority-store rollback and external monotonic anchor
hypothesis: A coherent rollback of the entire process-isolated checkpoint-authority SQLite store to an older internally valid snapshot must not resurrect an older authoritative generation when a separately retained authenticated monotonic anchor has advanced.
mechanism_gap_under_test: Pilots 10-11 detect direct record tamper/deletion and serialize concurrent writers, but the authority store currently contains both issued history and max_generation. A whole-store rollback can restore mutually consistent old rows and old metadata. This pilot tests that attack explicitly instead of assuming local HMAC integrity implies freshness.
frozen_rules: A locally self-consistent old authority-store snapshot is not proof of freshness.
The trusted minimum generation/root must be held outside the authority SQLite store being rolled back.
The anchor must authenticate generation and checkpoint digest together.
An old valid anchor below a separately supplied trusted minimum cannot authorize rollback.
A current anchor paired with a stale authority store must fail closed.
A stale anchor paired with a current authority store must fail closed when the trusted minimum has advanced.
Missing, malformed, forged, or scope-mismatched anchor material fails closed.
Two live authority processes must observe the same external minimum on the tested path.
Models/reviewers cannot set or lower the trusted minimum and gain no production/release authority.
Positive liveness at a higher generation is required.
No expected outcome may be altered post-run merely to obtain green CI.
falsification_conditions: A coherent old authority-store snapshot verifies at or above an externally retained newer minimum.
Old authority-store history plus an old valid anchor can lower effective trusted generation after the minimum advanced.
Store/anchor generation or digest mismatch is accepted.
Forged, missing, malformed, or substituted anchor material is treated as current authority.
A model/reviewer/request field can lower the trusted minimum.
The mechanism blocks all clean higher-generation liveness.
bounded_claim_if_passed: On the tested local process/SQLite path, coherent rollback of the checkpoint-authority store is prevented from resurrecting stale authority when freshness is checked against a separately retained authenticated monotonic anchor and caller-independent trusted minimum.
explicit_nonclaims: The local anchor is not an administratively independent trust domain.
Not protection against a hostile same-user OS able to replace every local file and secret.
Not distributed consensus or Byzantine tolerance.
